content.scenario: You signed up to help at a weekend volunteer event organized by your university's environmental club. However, you have just found out that you have an important exam on the same day.
tasks: Explain why you cannot attend the event.
Tell the coordinator what you like about the club.
Suggest another way you could help.
content.subject: Unable to attend the weekend event
content.sample_answer:
Dear Coordinator,

I'm writing to let you know that unfortunately I won't be able to attend the volunteer event this weekend. I have just found out that I have an important exam on the same day, and I need to prepare for it.

I really enjoy being part of the environmental club. I especially like the clean-up days, because they make our campus look much better and I meet interesting people there.

Even though I can't come on Saturday, I would be happy to help in another way. For example, I could make posters for the event or help prepare the materials on Friday evening.

Thank you for understanding.

Best regards,
Alex
